items.title: Scott Robinson interviewed by Monk Rowe,Chautauqua, New York, September 13, 1997
items.q: I did arrangements of a lot of Duke things and some different, kind of obscure tunes.

ctx.x: Interesting. You’ve done some writing too, is that correct?

Yeah. On the new record I chose not to do any composing. I just wanted to arrange. I did arrangements of a lot of Duke things and some different, kind of obscure tunes. But yeah I like to write, I like to compose. Frank Wess asked me to do some writing for him. He’s started an octet with two saxophones, just him and myself, and two trumpets and a trombone. It’s a really nice little band, and I’m very honored to be asked by such a great writer to write, and by such a great saxophone player to be the other…
Cool. What about — you’ve also done some writing for publications?
